correctness.rationale: The face complex is exhaustively enumerated from all 32000 partial-parent assignments, rejecting every directed cycle; explicit face counts agree with independent graph Laplacian rooted-forest polynomial. Exact mod-2 boundary ranks 23,211,981,2376,2592 together with d^2=0 and chain dimensions force identical rational ranks, yielding only H5 of rank432. Each of the 144 group elements acts simplicially and the signed fixed-face trace computes its Lefschetz number, whence H5 character because rational homology is concentrated in degrees 0 and 5. Values constant on 15 conjugacy classes. Exact inner products against the five S4 and three S3 character tables give the displayed nonnegative integer multiplicities, weighted total432 and two invariant copies; standalone extracted checker replay is required and records results.

value.rationale: K3,4 is the first asymmetric complete bipartite parameter adjacent to studied K2,4 and balanced K3,3, with a previously proven 432-sphere Morse complex. Its full group representation contains all fifteen irreducibles (multiplicities ranging 2 to 19), has a two-dimensional invariant subspace, and gives 15 symmetry traces not recoverable from known nonequivariant Betti numbers. This is a natural, complete equivariant invariant of a canonical graph complex, not a tiny arbitrary parameter slice or routine table recomputation.
